== Summary ==
Identified: [[Patrik Csapi]] (standing, long hair and a beard, black tank; same hair, beard, and face as [[:File:2024 World Championship Top 8.jpg]]), identified by [[Bill Bisco]] on 25 November 2026. Remaining faces unlabeled, including the player in a FIGRIN D'AN shirt; the player in an orange CANTINA-style tee looking down at a paper; and the seated player in a light plaid shirt, seen from behind.

Players in the gaming room during the [[2024 World Championship]].
